Soft pieces

Apple and curd pancakes

Túrós-almás csinta

6 months+ Sound idea 20 min 2 portions

Mash or break into very soft pieces. Use only pasteurized cottage cheese.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 small apple (grated and cooked until soft)
  • 1 egg (cooked through)
  • 60 g cottage cheese (pasteurized, preferably with no added salt)
  • 2 tbsp oats (about 20 g)
  • 1 tbsp plain wheat flour (about 10 g)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (thin film in the pan)

Allergens

eggmilkgluten

Method

  1. Grate the apple and cook it with a splash of water until soft, then mash it.
  2. Mix in the egg, cottage cheese, oats, and flour, and add no sugar and no salt.
  3. Cook small pancakes in a thin film of oil over low heat.
  4. Turn them and cook until the egg is fully set and the center is not wet.
  5. Cool and mash or break them for a 6-month-old.

Sound idea

Cooked apple, egg, pasteurized cottage cheese, oats, and a spoon of flour are already suitable at 6 months when the pancake is soft and fully set. The apple has to be grated and cooked so it mashes, and the cheese has to be pasteurized.

No salt or sugar is added. Cook the pancakes through, then mash or break them for a baby who is still gumming food.
